name: messaging-mastery
description: Step-by-step TDD microservices mastering Kafka, RabbitMQ, BullMQ, Postgres, and Redis
//workspaces: Workspaces enable monorepo management: 'packages/*' holds shared libraries (e.g. @messaging/shared), 'services/*' holds runnable microservices (api-gateway, order-service, payment-service). npm links them locally via symlinks without publishing to npm registry.
//hoisting: Workspaces use hoisting: dependencies in sub-packages (like amqplib, pg, ioredis) are lifted and installed into the single root node_modules/ folder to save disk space and avoid duplicate downloads, while local packages (@messaging/shared) are connected via symlinks.
